payload.summary: WA Health Language Services Guidelines recorded with publication date 2025-01-01 from a copyright line
payload.detail: The PDF shows only (c) 2025; day and month were assumed, which bends the never-infer-a-date rule. Two form 1A interpreter notes in data/forms-cultural-notes.json cite it. Next action: owner accepts, or the source is rejected with a reason and those two notes are dropped.
